circuits.name: Lakes and the Corbett edge
circuits.blurb: Short, gentle drives: the lake towns above Haldwani, then down to the sal forest at Ramnagar.

circuits.name: Almora, Jageshwar and Binsar
circuits.blurb: The old Chand capital, the Jageshwar temple group in its deodar valley, the Binsar ridge and Kausani's long view of the snows.

circuits.name: Caves and Shaktipeeths of the east
circuits.blurb: Champawat's temples, the Lohaghat hills, the Patal Bhuvaneshwar cave and the Chaukori tea-estate ridge.

circuits.name: To the high peaks: Munsiyari
circuits.blurb: A long hill drive to Munsiyari under the Panchachuli, back by the Kali valley at Dharchula.
